key_insight: Controlled forecasting evaluations show that retrieved evidence can matter as much as the LLM interpreting it.
engineering_relevance: Freeze and version retrieved evidence to distinguish model reasoning quality from search-source effects and retrospective information leakage.
method: Capture results from four commercial search APIs every two days for open prediction-market questions.
Replay frozen evidence offline after outcomes resolve.
Compare models, search sources, and memory strategies under a fixed evidence-acquisition policy.
evidence_signal: Across 150 questions, 614 evidence states, and 131k search results, all tested LLMs trailed the market; switching search APIs changed Brier scores by up to 0.043, exceeding the spread across models.
watch_item: Retrospective search is not a reliable substitute for archived evidence: post-settlement queries returned outcome-revealing results for up to 92% of questions despite tested date filters.
paper_title: ForecastGym: A Live, Controlled, and Replayable Benchmark for Forecasting Agents
